# Before you leave

Once the screensaver is up, computer use cannot recover by itself: input to the screensaver desktop is refused, and only a human touching the mouse clears it.
**If the screensaver fires, the run is over until you're back.** Claude can't dismiss it; someone has to move the mouse.

| Hazard | Effect |
|---|---|
| Screensaver or lock | Claude cannot get past it; it needs a human to wake the machine |
Only you can clear the lock screen once it appears.

fail.answer: If the screensaver comes on, Claude will just move the mouse and carry on.
